scopeAsStated: gallium production plant co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery
statementOriginal: The ceremony marked the start of construction of the new facility co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery in Western Australia.
statementEn: The ceremony marked the start of construction of the new facility co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery in Western Australia.
note: Alcoa reports that the August 24, 2026 groundbreaking ceremony marked the start of construction; Australian ministers describe the first sod turned. This candidate records the reported ceremony only, not independently observed sustained works, cash disbursement, commissioning or production.
